answer: One concrete defense is stake-gated transaction quotas: each identity may post only a small batch of orchard-fresh transactions per epoch. Raising the quota requires locking collateral, while auditor agents serve as a beacon, clustering identities by behavioral fingerprints like call timing, fee patterns, and error rates. A cluster judged to be one operator behind many masks loses its collateral. An attacker pays timber-for-timber cost: every fake identity demands locked capital that can be seized, so scaling Sybils from dozens to thousands becomes linearly ruinous instead of nearly free.
